name: Face Wash | Chando Naturals Neem Pimple Fighting Face Wash 100ml Daily Cleanser for Oily and Acne-Prone Skin
description:
Say goodbye to breakouts and hello to clear, refreshed skin with Chando Naturals Neem Pimple Fighting Face Wash. Infused with natural neem extract, this antibacterial cleanser fights pimples, acne, and excess oil without over-drying. Neem’s purifying and healing properties, combined with soothing botanicals, deeply cleanse pores, remove dirt, and reduce acne-causing bacteria. With regular use, skin appears clearer, calmer, and more balanced. Perfect for oily, combination, and acne-prone skin, it helps maintain a fresh, oil-free glow.
Key Features:
 Size: 100ml tube
 Enriched with natural neem extract for antibacterial action
 Targets pimples, acne, and excess oil
 Deep pore cleansing without stripping moisture
 Helps prevent future breakouts with regular use
 Suitable for oily, combination, and acne-prone skin
How to Use:
 Wet face with water
 Apply a small amount of face wash and lather
 Massage gently in circular motions
 Rinse thoroughly and pat dry
 Use twice daily for best results
Ingredients:
Neem extract, Aqua, Glycerin, Mild surfactants, Natural botanical agents
Safety Information:
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes; rinse immediately if contact occurs
 Discontinue use if irritation develops
 Keep out of reach of children
Package Includes:
 1 × Chando Naturals Neem Pimple Fighting Face Wash 100ml
